signals.text: Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Define, prioritize, and drive delivery of shared platform capabilities that solve business and clinical needs and align with the broader product vision.
Turn ambiguous business and clinical problems into clear product opportunities, including the problem to solve, desired outcomes, requirements, success metrics, and key tradeoffs.
Partner with engineers and business owners to decide when a need should become a reusable platform capability and when a one-off solution is the better fit, and identify patterns…
Work closely with Engineering and Design to shape and ship solutions, with enough technical depth to understand systems, integrations, dependencies, and constraints.
Use AI tools to test ideas quickly and step into engineering-adjacent work, such as specs, configuration, or data analysis, when it helps the team move faster.
